data.name: Baron
data.long_meaning: The name Baron comes from the Old German word ‘baro’ meaning freeman or nobleman. This title was used to describe a nobleman who held a large estate or territory. In feudal Europe, a Baron was a member of the nobility, ranking below a Count and above a Knight. The name carries the symbolism of independence, self-reliance, and leadership.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of noble character and independence in the face of adversity.
